newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tennis-Seles and Becker to defend Australian Open titles.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tennis-Seles and Becker to defend Australian Open titles.

text.p: Boris Becker and Monica Seles have confirmed they will defend their singles titles at the Australian Open in January, tournament organisers said.
"We certainly look forward to welcoming back our defending champions," tournament director Paul McNamee said in a statement.
Seles, a four-time Australian Open champion, crowned her comeback to tennis by winning at Melbourne Park this year, extending her unbeaten winning streak at the grand slam event to 28 matches.
She was sidelined from tennis for 28 months after being stabbed at a tournament in 1993.
Becker revived his career in Melbourne last January by clinching his first grand slam title for five years and his sixth in total.
"Monica's victory last year, overcoming such adversity, is one of sport's greatest achievements," McNamee said.

"It's also great to see Boris' entry, given the wrist injury problem he sustained at Wimbledon. Clearly his recent victory in Stuttgart over world number one Pete Sampras shows he's back in good form and we look forward to his return."
The Australian Open will be staged in Melbourne from January 13-26.
